resources.string: When off, audio is removed after transcription or failure.
Saved work stays locked to this account. Sign back into the same account to use it. Save a recovery file first if you need a separate copy.
Saved work stays on this device, locked to this account. Sign back into the same account to continue. Save a recovery file first if you need a separate copy.

Permanently deletes this account\'s local tasks, drafts and recordings from this device, including work not yet synced. Shared tasks already synced stay with the family. Save a recovery file before deleting if you need these local copies. This cannot be undone.
Reconnects this device. Saved text stays available for recovery; old actions are not sent to the family automatically.
The selected old device will no longer be able to send changes. Recover any unsynced work on that device before continuing.
No saved text to recover here.
The JSON recovery file can be imported into Bun Do. The text file is for reading or copying elsewhere.
This text is too long to copy as a task. Save a recovery file to keep it.
Bun can suggest adventures from at least three available main tasks. Or plan something new. You review the plan before starting it for the family.
Nothing completed yet in this period. Finish a task together and it will count after sync.
